label: Entailment
evidence: Regardless of the form, format, or media on or in which the Confidential Information is provided and regardless of whether any such Confidential Information is marked as such, “Confidential Information” means (1) any and all information provided by or made available by the State to the Contractor in connection with the Contract
reason: The definition covers any and all information provided by the State regardless of form, format, or media, which clearly implies that information conveyed verbally can be Confidential Information.
